title: 2026 Worker Co-op Conference
description: The annual national gathering for the US worker-cooperative movement, co-hosted by the U.S. Federation of Worker Cooperatives and the Democracy at Work Institute. Brings together worker-owners, co-op developers, policymakers, funders, and labor organizers for co-op tours, breakout sessions on business development and governance, skill-building, and advocacy. Primarily in-person, with local satellite events in other communities for people who can't travel to Boston.
